en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a circular stone fountain in the foreground of a cloistered courtyard. Behind the fountain is a stone bench and an arcade of round arches supported by columns along a building façade. The image is bordered by a wide cream margin. Below the photograph there is multilingual printed text identifying the scene as the fountain of the convent of Santa Isabel.
